summary: Jan–Jun 2026 crop 4,161.98 t (5.67 t/ha), 13% below budget of 4,805 t; tonnage slightly above same period 2025 (4,060.71 t) but on 95 ha more mature area.
Cost of production RM380.85/t FFB, within the to-date budget of RM385.63/t; all cost centres underspent in RM terms.
Labour is the main constraint: 26 harvesters vs 37 required (41 if wheelbarrow ratio used) and 4 sprayers vs 8.
Field upkeep lagging: no road grading or drain desilting done to June pending rates; circle spraying at 76% of to-date budget.
Pests: rat damage in P16/P18/P22 and bagworm in P18 awaiting trunk-injection licence; cattle intrusion case in court in September.

issues.title: Rat census statement vs PA table
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 6.8.1(b) says no follow-up rat damage census was done, yet the PA rat census table shows June 2026 pre-treatment damage of 18% (PM12D), 19% (PM16E), 18% (PM18F), 17% (PM20G) and 19% (PR22H), with baiting in June. Agronomy 1/2026 (Q1) had only PM16E, PM18F, PM20G censused.

issues.title: YTD yield decline is an area effect
issues.detail: PA 8.2 says yield to June is 11% below 2025 (5.67 vs 6.35 t/ha), but tonnage is actually up 2.5% (4,161.98 t vs 4,060.71 t). The fall is because mature area rose from 639.35 to 734.35 ha with P22H (96 ha, 2022 planting) now counted.

issues.title: Harvester count inconsistent within PA
issues.detail: PA labour table (June 2026) shows 26 harvesters vs 37 required (short 11); PA 3.1 says 28 available as at July at 1:20 ha, short 9; 3.2-3.3 revise the requirement to 41 at 1:18 ha (short 13); 3.4 says that with 2 recruits by 13/8/26 the estate would still be short 11. Agronomy 1/2026 (April) reported a shortage of six harvesters.

issues.title: Planting years wrong in PA area statement
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 area table lists PM00A/PM01B as 1995, PM02C/PM12D 2000, PM16E 2001, PM18F 2002, PM20G 2012; Agronomy 1/2026 gives 2000, 2001, 2002, 2012, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022 respectively, which matches the PA's own bunch-weight table and field codes.

issues.title: Annual budget hectarage typo
issues.detail: PA crop table shows annual-budget hectarage 639.35 ha, but the annual budget yield 14.09 t/ha only reconciles with 734.35 ha (10,350 t / 734.35).

issues.title: Palm census area mismatch
issues.detail: Agronomy 1/2026 palm density table uses block areas that differ from the area statement (e.g. PM16E 51.43 ha vs 42.06 ha, PM18F 73.23 vs 85.04, PM12D 136.07 vs 145.00). SPH also differs: PM02C 142 (PA pruning table) vs 132 (Agro GPS).

issues.title: Agro text contradicts its own Q1 yield table
issues.detail: Agronomy 1/2026 7.10 says only young mature P20 and P22 improved in Q1 2026, but Table 16 shows P00 also up 13.9% (2.42 to 2.76 t/ha).

issues.title: Date typo in manuring table
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 manuring table: PM18F 0.75 kg/palm application dated 19.06.26 but completed 17.06.26 (completion before start). Report's comments page is also headed 'PA REPORT 1- 2026' although it is report 2/2026.

kb:
LADANG TAGAR 2 (Tagar Properties Sdn Bhd, Prosper group) - FACT PACK
Sources: PA Report 2/2026 (Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, visit 7 August 2026, review period January to June 2026) and Agronomy Report 1/2026 (Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming, visit 9 April 2026, previous visit 29 October 2025, Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok). Senior Manager Mr. Paramaswarn a/l Thangavilu; Sr. Assistant in-charge En. Mohd Shalihuddin Bin Haron.

AREA (PA 2/2026, as at June 2026): Title 770.49 ha. Planted 734.35 ha, all mature (95.31%). Roads 23.95 ha, TNB rentice 1.19 ha, buildings/others 11.00 ha. No immature, replanting or nursery. Mature area rose from 639.35 ha to 734.35 ha because PR22H (96 ha) was declared mature in 2026. PA says no replanting plans for 2026 and 2027. Blocks: PM00A 160.63 ha, PM01B 68.00, PM02C 31.80, PM12D 145.00, PM16E 42.06, PM18F 85.04, PM20G 105.82, PM22H 96.00. Planting years per Agronomy 1/2026: 2000, 2001, 2002, 2012, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022 (the PA area table shows different years, treated as a typo). Planting material (PA/Agro): D/Hope or G/Hope, 101/IOI, AAR, DxP Special, DxP FELDA.
Agronomy 1/2026: oldest P00 (22% of area, over 25 years) recommended for replanting in 2027 (160.63 ha), P01B in 2028 (68 ha), due to tall palms, yields below 15 t/ha and poor access in unterraced ravines. Prime plantings 37% vs 48% target; about 17% of palms over 20 years; young mature 27%. Palm census (GPS SPH): PM00A 128 and 122, PM01B 113, PM02C 132, PM12D 135 and 133, PM16E 136, PM18F 120, PM20G 126, PR22H 120. SPH low in P18F, P20G, P22H; infilling repeatedly recommended but not done. P22 SPH about 12% below minimum.

LABOUR (PA 2/2026, June 2026): Total workers 51 vs 67 required (short 16): 16 local estate check-roll, 2 foreign check-roll, 33 contract workers (all 26 harvesters, 4 sprayers and 2 driver/loaders are contract). Harvesters 26 vs 37 (short 11). Sprayers 4 vs 8 (short 4). Manuring 9 workers plus 1 mandore (adequate). Driver plus loader 2 vs 3. Worker ratio 1:14 ha vs ideal 1:12 ha. Text: harvesters required 37 at 1:20 ha; 28 available as at July (1:26 ha), short 9; since wheelbarrows are used with no machines, ratio should be 1:18 ha, i.e. 41 required, short 13; 2 recruits expected by 13/8/26 would still leave a shortage of 11. Contractors: KT Palm, Dhaanika, MD Enterprise, Monirul, CK Permai, AK Guhan, Rohani Osman. Advised to engage a Bangladeshi contractor for spraying; Indonesian workers no longer interested in spraying. Housing issue with Labour Department: no progress reported. Agronomy 1/2026 noted a shortage of six harvesters in Q1.
STAFF (PA): no change; still short one office clerk for Pinfosys (Tagar 3 clerk assisting).

COSTS (PA 2/2026, to June 2026). General charges RM586,902.89 vs to-date budget RM654,942 (annual RM1,309,806); RM799.21/ha vs RM891.87/ha; underspent 10%. Upkeep and cultivation RM627,355.08 vs RM745,782 (annual RM1,491,467); RM854.30/ha vs RM1,015.57/ha; underspent 16%. Upkeep RM/ha actual vs budget: weeding 112.89 vs 132.50; manuring 652.81 vs 703.01; pest and diseases 22.28 vs 29.27; census 0.19 vs 0.88; drains 3.04 vs 29.39; road 15.33 vs 59.77; bridges 4.34 vs 11.96; boundary 0.97 vs 2.88; pruning 42.45 vs 45.91. Harvesting and collection RM370,841.95 vs RM452,244; RM89.10/t vs RM94.12/t (harvesting labour 63.71, internal transport 25.28, top-up wages 0.12 RM/t). Cost of production RM380.85/t FFB vs to-date budget RM385.63 and annual budget RM358.04 (general 141.02 vs 136.30; upkeep 150.73 vs 155.21; harvesting 89.10 vs 94.12). Per tonne CPO RM2,038.17 vs RM2,020.68. PA: production cost satisfactory under the circumstances. Tractor (New Holland) RM26.96/hr vs RM26.57 budget. Capex budget RM86,000 (buildings 15,000; residential 44,000; GPS 2,000; water pump motor 10,000; desilting water pond 15,000) - nothing spent to June.

CROP (PA 2/2026, to June 2026): FFB 4,161.98 t vs to-date budget 4,805 t and annual budget 10,350 t; same period last year 4,060.71 t; last year ANNUAL 12-MONTH BUDGET 12,230 t = 19.13 t/ha on 639.35 ha (this is last year's budget column, not an actual). Yield 5.67 t/ha vs 6.54 budget (13% below) and 6.35 same period last year (11% below, on a smaller 639.35 ha base). CPO 777.71 t, OER 18.69% vs 19.08% budget; kernel 208.09 t, KER 5.00%. Shortfall attributed to harvester shortage and low cropping season; crop picking up with good fruit sets in young mature blocks. Bunch weights June 2025 vs June 2026: 2000 planting 23.1 to 24.8 kg; 2001 24.3 to 23.5; 2002 20.7 to 21.1; 2012 20.2 to 21.8; 2016 13.8 to 15.7; 2018 11.1 to 13.6; 2020 7.2 to 9.7; 2022 2.0 to 4.2 kg.
YIELD (Agronomy 1/2026): 2025 estate 13.59 t/ha vs 14.32 in 2024 (minus 5.09%) on 638.3 ha. 2025 by block (2024 in brackets): P00 12.09 (14.65), P01 14.63 (15.84), P02 19.92 (20.47), P12 13.06 (15.38), P16 20.72 (23.46), P18 14.65 (12.50), P20 10.34 (7.36). P22 immature harvesting under 2 t/ha with only 11 rounds. Q1 2026 2.54 t/ha vs 2.57 Q1 2025 (minus 1.3%): P00 2.76, P01 2.35, P02 3.42, P12 2.46, P16 4.23, P18 2.67, P20 2.62, P22 1.17. Yield-limiting factors: incomplete crop recovery, manuring deviations (up to four months late in 2024), upkeep delays, bagworm (P12, P16, P18), harvester shortage. Rainfall not limiting.

HARVESTING (PA): 11 rounds to June vs 12 budget; interval averaged 14 days; outturn 93%; cutter-and-carrier with wheelbarrows, no machines. Productivity t/man-day and earnings: PM00A 1.09 (RM61.04), PM01B 1.12 (60.48), PM02C 0.94 (50.76), PM12D 1.23 (45.51), PM16E 1.91 (64.94), PM18F 1.54 (70.84), PM20G 1.44 (92.16), PM22H 0.79 (62.41); basic wage RM65.38. Rates RM34-79/t. Rates were set for mechanical evacuation (2.5-3 t/man-day expected); PA suggests revising rates for wheelbarrows. Agronomy 1/2026: intervals Jan-Mar 15-24 days; incomplete harvesting and rotten bunches in ravines of P00 and P01; oxidised loose fruit in P02 and P12D; flood-prone parts of P12D unattended.

MANURING: PA - 1,787 ha of 1,973 ha budgeted fertilised to June; late NK Mixture and Kieserite delivery; 20 bags/man-day broadcasting; check-roll workers at RM65.38/day. Agronomy 1/2026 - 2025 programme 100% complete (NK1 211.60 t, Mix B 468.1 t, kieserite 18.60 t, RP 111.00 t) but one to two months late. As of March 2026: Mix A 100%, Mix B 91% (112.30 of 123.95 t), NK2 100%, kieserite 23% (4.30 of 18.60 t). Need at least 80 t per month from April to finish by November. 2026 programme revised for price increases and limited stock. Bagworm - PA: 10.65 ha in P18/F sprayed with Cypermethrin; trunk injection licence awaiting DOA approval. Agronomy: Feb 2026 census P18 mean 18 larvae over about 20 ha. No new Ganoderma (PA).
